title: App Launch Day Announcement Poster
prompt:
[Format]
Vertical 9:16 launch poster, saturated orange ground with a phone mockup. Bold commercial render, no watermark, no brand logos.

[Layout]
Flat orange #FF5A1F fills the frame. A small white pill badge with an abstract mark sits in the upper left. The headline sits in the upper third, left aligned, two lines, very heavy and very large. A phone mockup rises from the bottom edge, centred slightly right, cropped by the bottom so only its upper two thirds show. A small white pill status chip overlaps the phone's lower left corner, and one monospace line sits under the headline.

[Subject]
a white phone mockup with a thin dark bezel, screen showing a pale card with a circular green check mark, a bold dark amount-free layout (a large dark bar, two thin grey bars) and a single green button shape at the bottom. No legible text on the screen.

[Headline]
"WE ARE LIVE." in a heavy grotesque, all caps, white #FFFFFF, two lines: "WE ARE" then "LIVE." - the period stays. Extremely tight leading so the two lines almost touch.

[Labels]
one monospace line beneath the headline in #FFE7DB: "launch day, no agency". On the phone's corner, a white pill with small orange monospace text inside: "shipped".

[Mood]
Hot orange, white, one green check. Loud and friendly, built for a phone screen; reads at thumbnail as a launch announcement rather than a discount.

Every line of text must be real, correctly spelled English - no placeholder, no lorem ipsum, no gibberish, no phone numbers, no email addresses, no QR codes, no bracketed placeholders. Never break or hyphenate a word across two lines: each word must stay whole on one line. Do not print any telephone number, street address, URL or price. All interface content inside any window, card or screen is abstracted: grey bars, soft blocks and blurred shapes only - no legible microcopy anywhere.
